guidelines.detail: documentation rule PROC-05 not applied (The description allows feedback or returns to trigger further actions after the successful-delivery process ends, while the generated start event is recorded as detached from the main flow. This supports modeling the later actions as an event subprocess or separate process. Documented guideline PROC-05 already covers this situation.)

refines GW-03 (The description identifies alternative ways to begin, and the missing flows show that their paths should converge before subsequent work. GW-03 covers exclusive merges for alternative paths; this guideline specifies its application to alternative entry channels and their shared flow.)

refines FID-03 (The generated labels omit a stated action or distinguishing detail, or substitute a broader action, compared with the description. This adds specific guidance for preserving label scope to the existing rule to use short, faithful labels.)

same as LRN-014 (The description identifies online and phone ordering as alternative initiation channels. The missing flows and start-to-gateway flow support modeling those alternatives as branches. This is already stated essentially the same way in learned guideline LRN-014.)

same as LRN-015 (The generated labels omit or alter details stated in the description, including an action, recipient, object, or alternatives. This guideline is already captured by learned guideline LRN-015.)

same as LRN-014 (The description specifies two alternative ways to initiate the same process, and the cited missing flows show that the corresponding branches and their convergence are absent. This is already captured by learned guideline LRN-014.)
same as LRN-015 (The label pairs show omitted actions, alternatives, recipients, or distinguishing objects compared with the description. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-015.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Give every process and every expanded subProcess its own explicit start event and end event. A trigger that occurs after the main flow (for example later feedback or a return) is joined to the main flow by a gateway, or modeled as an event subprocess or a separate process.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that an event may trigger actions after the main flow has ended

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a process can begin through alternative channels before continuing through a shared flow: Model each channel as a separate branch and merge the branches with an exclusive gateway before the shared flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a process can begin through alternative channels before continuing through a shared flow

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or event so its described scope remains identifiable. Preserve materially stated actions, alternatives, and objects or participants; do not substitute a broader or different action or add unsupported details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.
